meta.name: Languages
meta.about: Which elements speak which languages, generated from the built packages: 148 of 229 packages ship translations, almost all in 101 languages, from 40,604 translation files. The rest either have strings ready to translate or show no text.

lg_manager.desc: i18n-manager: the singleton every element registers with. It knows the reader's language, loads each element's translation file on demand and tells elements when the language changes.

lg_mixin.desc: I18NMixin: what an element extends to get a this.t object of English strings and have it swapped for the reader's language.

lg_registry.desc: languages.json: the canonical registry. 102 languages with English and native names and writing direction, plus 32 regional variants that resolve to their parent.

lg_manifest.desc: translation-manifest.json: built by scanning the elements. 231 elements scanned, 148 with translations, 40,604 translation files.

lg_files.desc: Each element keeps locales/<tag>.<lang>.json for its own strings and locales/<tag>.haxProperties.<lang>.json for its editor labels.

lg_picker.desc: haxcms-language-picker: the site setting that chooses a site's language, which the editor and every element on the page follow.

lg_full.desc: 147 packages are translated into 100 or more languages.

lg_partial.desc: 1 packages have some translation files: example-hax-element.

lg_ready.desc: 3 packages already keep their strings in this.t but have no translation files yet, so they are the next to translate.

lg_none.desc: 78 packages show no text of their own (behaviors, utilities, wrappers), so there is nothing to translate.

lg_rtl.desc: 8 languages written right to left: Arabic, Hebrew, Pashto, Persian, Sindhi, Urdu, Western Punjabi, Yiddish. Elements flip their layout for these.

lg_variants.desc: 32 regional variants, such as ar-SA, ca-ES, cs-CZ, da-DK, de-DE, el-GR, resolve to their parent language's files.

b_clean_two.desc: @haxtheweb/clean-two: keeps its strings in this.t; no translation files yet.

b_simple_icon_picker.desc: @haxtheweb/simple-icon-picker: keeps its strings in this.t; no translation files yet.

b_terrible_themes.desc: @haxtheweb/terrible-themes: keeps its strings in this.t; no translation files yet.

tours.label: Every element, every language
tours.message: 148 packages translated into 101 languages, and how it works.

scenes.caption: Elements extend I18NMixin and register with i18n-manager.
Translations live next to each element, indexed by a manifest and a shared language registry.
The hax-i18n-translate skill writes them; the site's language picker chooses one.
Right to left languages flip the layout.
